description: This file defines the class ParameterIdsTableModel which extends DefaultTableModel to represent parameter ID data in a table model for a GUI application. It manages a parameter list mapping parameter names to logger IDs, providing methods to retrieve table data and define column characteristics.

classes.name: ParameterIdsTableModel
classes.description: A table model for displaying parameter names and their corresponding logger IDs, extending DefaultTableModel.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table, based on the colNames array.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified column.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific cell, based on the parameter list mapping.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows, equal to the size of the parameter list.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of data in the column based on the first row's data.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Indicates whether a specific cell is editable; in this case, always false.

methods.name: setParameterList
methods.description: Sets the parameter list map used as data source for the table.
